tolerance.note: stored strings byte-exact (JSON.stringify of the values), listener call order exact, numbers bit-exact

data.note: case: {stored (raw localStorage string, absent = nothing stored), unavailable (storage throws), reduced (prefers-reduced-motion), coarse (pointer: coarse), search (location.search), actions}; log rows: ['probe', JSON.stringify(values), stored, pixelRatioCap(), detail(), autoAssist(), BINDINGS] | ['call', listenerId, key, value] | ['stored', string after a set()]; actions: ['listen', id, [{when: key, set|off|listen}]] | ['off', id] | ['set', key, json] | ['setNaN', key] | ['probe']

progress.note: ['load', raw, JSON.stringify(loadProgress())] | ['save', data (NaN/±Infinity serialised as null, -0 as 0 here), stored string]; the save rows' data is re-parsed from JSON, see export-core.mjs for the exact inputs
